top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Jump as Huang’s Return Lifts AI Trade: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian shares rallied as Jensen Huang’s return to lead Nvidia Corp. revived enthusiasm for the artificial intelligence trade, helping the region’s major chipmakers rebound from last week’s rout.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: BTCS offloads $44M in ETH to reduce DeFi debt amid market downturn
top_signals.summary: BTCS sold more than half its Ether holdings to reduce leverage following the market sell-off, while BitMine added another 7,819 ETH to its treasury.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
